name: Paradigm Shift ~Mezame no Toki~
original_name: パラダイム・シフト～目醒めの時～
source:
Brutal murders are occurring at Shiramine School because the students become possessed by demons. The protagonist, Ootori Kirio, must purify the students by having sex with them.

[summarized from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=24354]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
白峰學園接連發生殘忍的殺人事件，原因是學生們遭到惡魔附身。主角鳳桐雄必須藉由與她們性交來淨化她們。
